info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 本課程探討硬體系統之安全，介紹硬體設計可能產生之漏洞與安全威脅，將包含旁通道攻擊、錯誤注入攻擊等實體攻擊方法及其反制之道，另外也將學習應用於建立安全系統的最新安全硬體元件。
description.describe_eh: In this course, we will study security from the hardware perspective. We will introduce the basics of hardware design as well as possible vulnerabilities and security threats of hardware implementations. Different types of physical attacks such as side-channel attacks, fault-injection attacks, etc. and their countermeasures will be included. We will also learn about new hardware security primitives aiming for the construction of secure systems.
